# orly

> A guard check for coding agents. The agent turns the user's request into guards (one yes/no
> question each, a shell command where one decides it). At every stop the open guards are
> checked against the recorded turn in one TypeSafe/Jev request; an unmet guard refuses the
> stop and the agent keeps working until all are upheld. One file, `orly.ts`, run with bun.

- [README](README.md): what it does, install, the guard commands, environment.
- [Skill](skills/orly/SKILL.md): how the agent writes guards and answers a refused stop.
- [Claude Code adapter](install/claude/adapter.ts): the hook, registered by install/claude/hooks.json.
- [Codex CLI adapter](install/codex/adapter.ts): the plugin hook, registered by install/codex/hooks.json; reads rollout transcripts.
